Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Yojana (12th Pass)
Bhil CommunityEducationFinancial AssistanceScootyWomen Empowerment
Details
The scheme “Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Yojana (12th Pass)” launched by the Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support meritorious girl students by providing scooters or ₹40,000 to eligible girl students pursuing higher education after Class 12th.
Benefits
Scooter: Eligible meritorious girl students receive a scooter under the scheme.
Additional Benefits with Scooter:
Transportation and Registration Charges: Includes registration, transfer in the student’s name, and delivery expenses.
1-Year General Insurance: 1-year insurance coverage for the scooter.
5-Year Third-Party Insurance: 5-year third-party insurance coverage.
2 Litres of Petrol: Provided once at the time of distribution.
1 Helmet: Given at the time of scooter delivery.
Eligibility
The applicant must have passed Class 12th with a minimum of 65% marks from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education or 75% marks from the Central Board of Secondary Education.
The applicant must be studying in any school or college located in Rajasthan.
The applicant must be a regular student in Class 12th in a government or private school, including residential schools run by the State Government.
Marks obtained in supplementary examinations will not be counted in the prescribed percentage.
The applicant must be pursuing a regular graduate degree from any college in Rajasthan (such as B.A. B.Ed., B.Sc. B.Ed., B.Com. B.Ed., B.E., B.Tech., B.Arch., MBBS, IIT, BBA, BBM, BCA, BDS, BHMS, BAMS, LAW, etc.).
The applicant must not have a gap of one year between passing Class 12th and admission to a graduate degree course.
The applicant may receive benefits from this scheme even if receiving financial assistance from any other scheme.
However, if the student has received a scooter based on Class 10th results from the TAD Department or School Education Department, she will receive ₹40,000/- under this scheme if eligible.
The annual income of the student’s parents must not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
Under the TAD Department, all eligible students from families exempt from income tax are eligible for benefits.
Application Process
Online - Via CSCs
Contact with nearest E-mitra center to apply for this service.
Documents Required
Senior Secondary Examination mark sheet.
Certificate issued by the head of the institution stating that the student has passed Class 12th as a regular student in a government or private school.
Details of the college or any other higher education/training institution and course currently being pursued after passing the Senior Secondary Examination, along with a certificate from the head of the institution. A self-attested photocopy of the TSP domicile certificate/caste certificate/minority certificate/economically backward class certificate/specially backward class certificate (whichever is applicable) issued by the competent authority must be attached.
Income certificate (not older than 6 months).
Self-attested copy of the BPL card for BPL students.
Copy of Jan Aadhaar card/Aadhaar card.
Self-attested copy of the certificate issued by the Medical Board for differently-abled students.
